formal_title: Carrier-Rule Separating Intervention, Property-Specific Edge Semantics, Multi-Hop Transport Composition, All-Edges-Carry↔Single-Gap Rival Divergence, Fourth-Mechanism Compatibility-Obligation Replication, Surface-Interaction↔Path-Transport Grammar Bridge, Leave-Two-Out Recovery & Macro-Law Family Decomposition Trial

mathematical_preseal.object: Property-indexed boundary transport over a directed path/category.

base_structure.software_graph: Directed multigraph G or its free path category Path(G).
base_structure.properties: A family O of transported semantic properties/capabilities/obligations.
base_structure.edge_semantics: For each edge e and property o, a transport map T_e^o on property state; Boolean carrier is the special case c_e(o) in {0,1}.

theorem_0_fake_rival_equivalence.statement: For Boolean carrier status c_e(o)∈{0,1}, ALL_EDGES_CARRY(p,o)=1 iff there exists no carrier gap on p.
theorem_0_fake_rival_equivalence.consequence: P21 R4_ALL_EDGES_MUST_CARRY and R5 carrier_gap? are not empirically separable if R5 means existence of any gap. Treating them as independent rivals is invalid.

new_separable_rivals.rule: Any non-carrying edge sends PRESENT→LOST and LOST is absorbing under all later edges.
A later explicit repair/reconstitution edge may send LOST→PRESENT.
new_separable_rivals.algebra: Transformation monoid containing a nontrivial reset/reconstitution map.

new_separable_rivals.rule: Outcome depends only on multiset/count of carrier and gap edges, not order.
T_b∘T_a may differ from T_a∘T_b; boundary order matters.
Each edge has one carrier status shared by all semantic properties.
The same edge may carry one property while dropping or transforming another.

prospective_theorem_targets.statement: If boundary semantics compose associatively and identity boundaries act identically, property transport defines a functor from Path(G) into a transformation category on property states.
Under Boolean, irreversible carrier semantics, every path quotient collapses to whether any gap exists; path order and gap multiplicity become unidentifiable.
If a repair edge r satisfies r(LOST)=PRESENT, then paths gap;r and gap are distinguishable, so the Boolean all-edges-carry quotient is not sufficient.
If there exist edges a,b and property state o with T_b(T_a(o))≠T_a(T_b(o)), then carrier semantics is not representable by any order-invariant edge-count statistic.

fourth_mechanism_target.required_domain: Fresh and mechanistically distinct from Rust method resolution, Ruby keyword forwarding, and Go ResponseController.
fourth_mechanism_target.preferred: A genuine compatibility obligation with multi-hop adaptation or explicit reconstitution, not merely capability traversal.
strong_family_shape: optional reordered repair/gap contrast if naturally available
fourth_mechanism_target.goal: Separate irreversible Boolean loss from repairable/order-sensitive transport.
fourth_mechanism_target.support_only_if: Only direct/gap cells exist or compatibility semantics is inferred rather than source/test explicit.

surface_path_bridge.candidate_common_grammar: A policy surface is a quotient of compositional transport states observed at a decision boundary.
surface_path_bridge.Rust_mapping_candidate: call geometry selects which transport/action morphism is exposed at a local surface.
surface_path_bridge.Ruby_Go_mapping_candidate: path composition determines which semantic state arrives at the decision boundary.
surface_path_bridge.precommit: Do not force a single grammar if a typed law-family decomposition fits with lower assumptions.

law_family_decomposition_rivals.claim: Rust/Ruby/Go/fourth family are projections of one compositional property-transport law.
Surface-selection interactions and path-transport interactions are distinct law families linked only by a higher-level decision interface.
No stable cross-mechanism law family survives beyond descriptive analogy.

leave_two_out_recovery.goal: After fourth exact family, require at least one carrier exact family to remain in training when Ruby+Go-like mechanisms are held out; otherwise no recovery claim.

forbidden: calling an empirical software pattern a theorem without explicit abstraction map
promoting category-theoretic vocabulary merely because it sounds elegant
pure_math_lane.deliverable: A small formal note plus executable finite-model witness/countermodel.
